__base__.name: reflexes-cope
__base__.description: reflexes-cope — optional academicOps plugin providing axiom-derived policy assembly and advisory evaluation

evaluator_model.title: Evaluator Model
evaluator_model.description: Model ID used for evaluating policy adherence (default: claude-3-5-haiku-20241022). Not yet wired: evaluate_cope_policy() is currently a stub, see reflexes-cope/README.md#customisation-surface.

provider.title: Evaluator Provider
provider.description: LLM provider for policy evaluation (default: anthropic). Not yet wired: evaluate_cope_policy() is currently a stub, see reflexes-cope/README.md#customisation-surface.

timeout_seconds.title: Evaluator Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for evaluator LLM calls before failing open (default: 5.0). Not yet wired: evaluate_cope_policy() is currently a stub, see reflexes-cope/README.md#customisation-surface.

fail_open.title: Fail Open on Exception
fail_open.description: Return an allow verdict on evaluator exceptions or timeouts (default: true). Not yet wired: evaluate_cope_policy() is currently a stub, see reflexes-cope/README.md#customisation-surface.
